Fresh final followup review of fragment_freshness. Saved/read previous complete report and inputs, started fresh and compared all initial fragments: claim, whole review.rs and all eight tests are unchanged. Recaptured fixture and check-stage helper unchanged. Located the prior intended finish_anchor helper after the preceding association-comment insertion and recaptured it at 418-434 instead of 417-433; exact contents are unchanged. No freshness behavior changed.

The full claim requires record and check to resolve every current selector and compare exact selected text, rejecting missing/ambiguous/invalid selections or changed text regardless of selector kind or input origin. The sole ordinary input_errors association compares fresh current inventory's initial fragment prefix and association metadata, then reselects every additional fragment and compares exact contents.join(newline). Current inventory reconstructs whole implementation files and complete claim/test selections and checks test identity ambiguity globally, including across anchors. WholeFile reads exact UTF-8 source; LineRange enforces inclusive one-based bounds and preserves CRLF/last-line distinctions; Claim resolves canonical ID/source and returns normalized claim text; Test requires exactly one distinct matching source span for its semantic identity. Missing/escaping paths and invalid inventory fail. record checks before completion; validate and acceptable use the same freshness path at checking time. No normalization beyond a selector's specified claim text substitutes for exact equality.

All eight unchanged ordinary tests remain substantive: ambiguous_initial_test_selector_cannot_be_recorded_as_complete_context rejects cfg-separated duplicate identities at start/record and gate; ambiguous_test_identity_across_anchors_is_rejected covers the global case; another_anchors_test_read_tracks_body_and_identity changes, renames or duplicates a separately read test and requires record failure without output even when initial inputs remain unchanged. declared_claim_read_tracks_selected_text_without_capturing_the_document asserts exact claim text, tolerates unrelated preceding heading and rejects changed selected prose. disappeared_or_invalidated_additional_fragments_reject_recording removes a WholeFile or invalidates a LineRange, requiring named errors, absent output, preserved input and failed check. invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review rejects changed initial implementation content without rewriting captures. test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement asserts exact function and metadata, survives unrelated line movement and rejects cfg changes. whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits checks CRLF/blank/unterminated lines, invalid bounds, outside-versus-selected edits, repeated exact reads and final-newline staleness.

Together the visible assertions cover record/check enforcement, all four selector kinds, initial/additional inputs and identity ambiguity. Captured fixture creates actual isolated source/model files and invokes production APIs; check helper confirms integration and finish_anchor defines selected claim normalization. No TODO/N/A associations or deferrals exist. The only actual delta is helper position after the marker, with exact intended contents verified; the full prior assessment remains justified. No source edits, builds or tests occurred; fresh review commands and source inspection only. No requested edits.
